components.css: .ds-tile { display: block; max-width: 420px; text-decoration: none; color: #fff; } .ds-tile-img { display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; padding: 6% 12%; background: var(--beige); overflow: hidden; } .ds-tile-img svg { width: 100%; transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-img svg { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-tile-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 14px 12px 18px; background: var(--navy); transition: background-color 0.25s; } .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-bar { background: var(--navy-ink); } .ds-tile-label { display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-tile-mark { font: 500 1.0625rem/1.2 var(--serif); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-amp { font-style: italic; color: var(--gold-on-navy); letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-tile-name { font: 400 0.8125rem/1.4 var(--sans); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82); } .ds-chev { width: 26px; height: 26px; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: var(--gold-on-navy); stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tile:hover .ds-chev { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--navy); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-form { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; border: 1.5px solid var(--navy); background: var(--paper); border-radius: 0; } .ds-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 12px 16px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-cell:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-cell:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--navy); } .ds-cell label { font: 600 0.75rem/1.2 var(--note); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--navy-ink); } .ds-cell label span { letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: none; font-weight: 500; color: var(--navy-quiet, #4a5f7d); } .ds-cell input { width: 100%; margin-top: 6px; padding: 6px 0; border: 0; background: transparent; font: 400 1.125rem/1.4 var(--sans); color: var(--navy-ink); outline: none; }

narrative.northStar: The Group Portal in Brand Ink
narrative.overview:
The site works like a capital group's corporate portal: a white page with a two-row header, breadcrumbs, a section sidebar, and content laid out in plain ruled blocks. What makes it FLEET&FLOAT is the ink. Navy and gold come straight from the logo files, and every division name in a brand position is set the way the logo sets it, in Bodoni Moda capitals spaced wide with an italic gold ampersand. Explanatory text is plain Barlow.

Density is orderly and informational rather than theatrical. Grounds are white, light grey bands (#f2f3f5) hold the contact section, the other-divisions strip, the footer's legal row and the tile image fields, and hairline navy-tinted rules separate everything else. The signature object is the group diagram on the home page: four quarter-circle segments in navy and gold tones around the light-ground sygnet, with text set around the ring. Depth is almost absent. Corners are square, surfaces stay flat, and interaction shows as a change of tone, position or scale rather than as lift.

The brand assets are binding: the logo files and the sygnet are used as supplied, in the colours of their ground.
keyCharacteristics: Corporate portal frame: utility links row, logo plus main menu row, breadcrumbs, a 240px section sidebar on group pages.
White ground, light grey (#f2f3f5) bands, navy-tinted hairline rules; square corners everywhere.
Division marks in logo notation: spaced Bodoni capitals with the italic gold ampersand.
Group diagram: four quarters around the sygnet that slide outward and brighten on hover.
Area tiles: a grey drawing field over a navy name bar; on hover the drawing zooms in, the bar darkens and the chevron slides.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Navy and gold are the only chromatic families. Gold marks, underlines and rings. Navy carries what you read. The diagram's extra tones (a lighter navy and two dark golds) belong to those families and are confined to the diagram.

rules.name: The Ground-Matched Gold Rule
rules.body: Use gold on white and grey, gold-on-navy on navy fills, and gold-deep-text whenever gold has to be read as text on a light ground. Don't swap them.

rules.name: The Logo Notation Rule
rules.body: A division or group mark (page heading, tile bar, diagram quarter, footer brand row, other-divisions strip, form division select) is set in Bodoni capitals at 0.12–0.14em spacing, with an italic ampersand in the ground-matched gold. Never set a mark's ampersand roman.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks for the Brand Rule
rules.body: Bodoni is reserved for marks, the uppercase contact headline, table row heads and the form's division select. Page headings, navigation, explanation, labels and controls are Barlow.

rules.name: The Portal Frame Rule
rules.body: Group-level pages keep the corporate frame: two-row header, breadcrumbs, and the section sidebar on the left.

rules.name: The Tone, Not Lift Rule
rules.body: Hover is shown by darkening (tile bar, button), tinting (sidebar links, other-division cells), moving (diagram quarters by 6px outward, chevrons and arrows by 3–4px) or scaling inside a clipped field (tile drawing to 1.05). Surfaces never rise.

rules.name: The Square Sheet Rule
rules.body: No border-radius on any interface surface. Rounding is allowed only inside the supplied app icon, line drawings and small stroke icons.

dos: Do keep the portal frame on group pages: two-row header, breadcrumbs, 240px section sidebar.
Do set every division and group mark in Bodoni capitals at 0.12–0.14em with the italic ampersand in the ground-matched gold.
Do build on white with band grey (#f2f3f5) for secondary bands, and separate content with rule and rule-soft hairlines.
Do use gold-deep-text, not gold, when gold has to be read as text on a light ground.
Do show hover as tone, offset or clipped scale (tile bar to ink navy, diagram quarter 6px outward, drawing to 1.05), never as lift.
Do mark illustrative drawings as such and show missing facts with the draft marker.
donts: Don't redraw or recolour the logo files. Use the variant that matches the ground.
Don't round corners on any interface surface.
Don't set running text in gold or add a chromatic family beyond navy and gold. Rust is for errors only.
Don't put shadows on surfaces, except the Proof Frame around a raster screenshot.
Don't set a mark's ampersand roman or in the wrong gold for its ground.
